request: Build a media player app in a single HTML file. It shows a playlist of tracks with play, pause, previous, and next controls, a draggable seek bar with current and total time, volume control, shuffle and repeat modes, animated visualizer bars, keyboard shortcuts (space plays/pauses, arrow keys skip), and persists the playlist order, shuffle flag, repeat flag, and volume in localStorage.

intent.goal: media player app in a single HTML file.

planFiles.summary: Media player HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file

libraryContext: media player with synth tones, playlist, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, visualizer, keyboard shortcuts, localStorage persistence
